validation.aggregation: Latest result for each unique test across the listed result bundles; fixed cases were rerun.

storage.cookies: Per-server WebKit profiles; completed validation transfers the live WKWebView to API transport. Reset removes that session and cookies. API fetches stay on the configured HTTPS origin, reject redirects, and isolate credentials from page JavaScript.
storage.preferences: Mode-specific appearance/grid values and a separate Booru reader preferences suite; existing Hitomi values and previous Booru-only options preserved

limits: Some legacy tag searches require an additional interactive site verification. Automated tests do not solve human checks; Validate Client opens the challenged search URL, and embedded browsing is available.
Sites may temporarily throttle pagination. The client surfaces rate-limit errors; live legacy pagination passed with paced requests.
Public Gelbooru/Old Gelbooru adapters depend on website HTML. Server availability, account permissions and supported media codecs still apply.
Explicit translation target languages require iOS 18+ Apple Translation. System-default image translation uses VisionKit. Videos are excluded.
Booru favorites remain local and separate from Hitomi backup/export.

network_diagnostics.danbooru: Broad popular/score UI passed. Native API also passed in the final unit run. HTTP 500 score queries use disjoint descending score bands without dropping lower scores.
network_diagnostics.gelbooru: Visible validation -> native public list -> actual image viewer passed. A connection-loss recurrence exposed dropping validated views while subresources were still loading; adoption and DOM readiness were fixed. Final live native endpoint and UI checks passed.
network_diagnostics.old_gelbooru: The homepage opened while the parameterized listing returned a browser challenge. Validation now targets public listings or the exact failed request. Empty first pages omit default tags/offsets; public HTML is read through WebKit navigation. Three configured legacy sites passed listings, original metadata and pagination; one also passed the visible viewer.
network_diagnostics.remaining: A selected legacy tag search requested interactive verification. The test verified that Validate Client opens that precise search instead of the homepage, then skipped awaiting a human check. Native browser fallback is available in Settings and error cards.
network_diagnostics.safebooru: Live API, autocomplete, browser API transport and native image/zoom passed. Readiness now waits for a committed DOM before JavaScript execution.
